Book correction: The answer key (Answers 9.1) prints -\sqrt{2} \le x \le \sqrt{2}. This is incomplete: it is only Case B (x^2 - 3 \le -1). Case A (x^2 - 3 \ge 1, i.e. |x| \ge 2) is left out, although for example h(2) = \csc^{-1}(1) = \frac{\pi}{2} is defined. The correct domain is (-\infty, -2] \cup [-\sqrt{2}, \sqrt{2}] \cup [2, \infty).
